title: Taleggio Lasagna
description: A creamy, cheesy lasagna dish featuring the rich flavors of Taleggio cheese. This Italian-inspired recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine Taleggio cheese, mascarpone cheese, and Italian seasoning. Mix well to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
In a large baking dish, spread a layer of the cheese mixture on the bottom.
Arrange 4 cooked lasagna noodles on top of the cheese layer.
Spread half of the remaining cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the Parmesan cheese mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the cheese mixture, and finally the Parmesan cheese mixture.
Drizzle the top with olive oil and season with salt to taste.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
